khmer: វិចិត្រករ
breakdown: 画(painting)+家(expert, master) — a master of painting

examples.py: Tā shì yí wèi yǒumíng de huàjiā.

examples.en: I want to be a painter.

examples.py: Zhè wèi huàjiā huà de hěn hǎo.

examples.en: A painter needs a lot of practice.

examples.cn: 这幅画是一位老画家画的。
examples.py: Zhè fú huà shì yí wèi lǎo huàjiā huà de.
examples.en: This painting was done by an old painter.

khmer: វិចិត្រសិល្បៈ
breakdown: 美(beautiful)+术(skill, technique) — the skill of making beauty

examples.py: Wǒ duì měishù hěn gǎn xìngqù.

examples.en: There is an art class today.

examples.py: Zhè shì yì suǒ měishù xuéxiào.
Měishùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō huà.
examples.en: There are many paintings in the art museum.

english: to get; to obtain; to gain
khmer: ទទួលបាន
breakdown: 彳(walking radical)+旦+寸 — reaching out and getting something

examples.py: Tā dé le dì yī míng.
Kǎoshì wǒ dé le jiǔshí fēn.
examples.en: I got ninety on the exam.

examples.py: Tā dé le yí ge jiǎng.
Nǔlì cái néng dé dào chénggōng.

examples.cn: 生病以后他得了很多照顾。
examples.py: Shēngbìng yǐhòu tā dé le hěn duō zhàogù.
examples.en: After getting sick he received a lot of care.

khmer: ជោគជ័យ
breakdown: 成(accomplish)+功(achievement) — achieving what you set out to do

examples.en: Only through effort can you succeed.

khmer: គិតថា (ជាញឹកញាប់ខុស)
breakdown: 以(take as)+为(be) — taking it to be so, often wrongly

examples.py: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bù lái le.

examples.en: I thought today was a holiday.

examples.cn: 我以为他是老师，其实是学生。
examples.py: Wǒ yǐwéi tā shì lǎoshī, qíshí shì xuésheng.
examples.en: I thought he was a teacher, actually he's a student.

khmer: រឿង / កិច្ចការ
breakdown: 事(matter)+情(situation) — a matter and its circumstances

examples.py: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
examples.en: I have many things to do.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shìqing gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.en: This matter has nothing to do with me.

khmer: តាមពិត
breakdown: 其(that, its)+实(real) — the real truth of it

examples.en: Actually this question is very simple.
In fact he is very young.

examples.py: Qíshí wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le.
examples.en: Actually I knew a long time ago.

examples.py: Kàn qǐlái nán, qíshí hěn róngyì.
examples.en: It looks hard, but actually it's easy.

english: if only; so long as; as long as
khmer: គ្រាន់តែ / ឲ្យតែ
breakdown: 只(only)+要(need) — you only need this much

examples.en: As long as you try, you'll succeed.

examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
examples.en: As long as you come, I'm happy.
As long as you persist, there will be results.

examples.py: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù yuèdú.
examples.en: Whenever I have time, I read.

examples.cn: 只要不下雨，我们就出发。
examples.py: Zhǐyào bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù chūfā.
examples.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll set off.

english: to insist; to persist; to keep at it
khmer: ព្យាយាមបន្ត / ទទូច
breakdown: 坚(firm, hard)+持(hold, 扌hand radical) — holding firmly

examples.en: I stand by my own view.

examples.cn: 学语言要坚持才有效果。
examples.py: Xué yǔyán yào jiānchí cái yǒu xiàoguǒ.
examples.en: Learning a language works only with persistence.

english: ideal; hope for the future; dream
khmer: ឧត្តមគតិ
breakdown: 理(reason)+想(think) — what reason and thought aim at

examples.py: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng huàjiā.
examples.en: My dream is to be a painter.

examples.py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng.
Zhè bú shì lǐxiǎng de jiéguǒ.

examples.en: You must work hard for your dreams.

examples.py: Tā shíxiàn le zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng.

khmer: សម្រេច / ធ្វើឲ្យក្លាយជាការពិត
breakdown: 实(real)+现(appear) — making something become real

examples.py: Tā shíxiàn le zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng.

examples.en: This plan is hard to accomplish.

examples.cn: 只要坚持，理想就能实现。
examples.py: Zhǐyào jiānchí, lǐxiǎng jiù néng shíxiàn.
examples.en: As long as you persist, your dream can come true.

khmer: គូរ / រូបគំនូរ
breakdown: Whole shape — a hand drawing lines inside a frame

examples.py: Qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng dà huà.
examples.en: There is a big painting on the wall.

khmer: វិទ្យាល័យ
breakdown: 高(high, senior)+中(middle school) — the senior part of middle school

examples.en: He graduated from senior high school.
There is a lot of homework in senior high.
We are senior high school classmates.
After senior high you go to university.

khmer: ថ្នាក់រៀន
breakdown: 年(year)+级(level) — your year level

examples.py: Wǒ shì èr niánjí de xuésheng.
examples.en: I am a second year student.

examples.py: Zhège niánjí yǒu wǔ ge bān.
Tā bǐ wǒ gāo yí ge niánjí.
examples.en: He is one grade above me.

examples.py: Gāo niánjí de kè bǐjiào nán.

khmer: បណ្ដោះអាសន្ន
breakdown: 暂(brief)+时(time) — a brief time

examples.cn: 这个问题暂时解决不了。
examples.py: Zhège wèntí zànshí jiějué bu liǎo.
examples.en: This problem can't be solved for now.
I don't want to change for now.

khmer: ឈប់ / បញ្ឈប់
breakdown: 停(stop)+止(halt) — two 'stop' characters together

khmer: ជក់គំនូរ
breakdown: 画(painting)+笔(pen, brush) — a brush for painting

examples.en: The painter paints with a brush.

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yì zhī xīn huàbǐ.
examples.en: I bought a new painting brush.

examples.py: Zhè zhī huàbǐ hěn hǎo yòng.

examples.en: The painting brush is on the table.

english: to work as; to be; when
khmer: ធ្វើជា
breakdown: Whole shape — read dāng for 'serve as' or 'at the time of'

examples.en: I want to be a painter.

examples.cn: 当我到家的时候，天黑了。
examples.py: Dāng wǒ dào jiā de shíhou, tiān hēi le.
examples.en: When I got home, it was dark.
She used to be a teacher.
As a student you must work hard.

english: to resign; to quit one's job
khmer: លាឈប់ (ការងារ)
breakdown: 舌(tongue)+辛 — words used to take leave; to resign

examples.py: Tā cí le gōngzuò qù liúxué.
examples.en: She quit her job to study abroad.

examples.py: Tā wèile lǐxiǎng cí le gōngzuò.
examples.en: He quit his job for his dream.

khmer: ទស្សនាកម្សាន្ត
breakdown: 游(roam, travel)+览(look over) — traveling around to look at sights

examples.en: In summer we'll go sightseeing in Beijing.

examples.cn: 游览的时候要注意安全。
examples.py: Yóulǎn de shíhou yào zhùyì ānquán.

examples.cn: 游客们在游览美丽的景色。
examples.py: Yóukèmen zài yóulǎn měilì de jǐngsè.
examples.en: The tourists are touring the beautiful scenery.

english: just right; just enough; as it happens
khmer: ល្មមណាស់ / ស្រាប់តែ
breakdown: 正(exactly)+好(good) — exactly good

examples.en: You came at just the right time.

examples.py: Wǒ zhènghǎo yě yào qù nàr.
examples.en: As it happens I'm going there too.
The temperature is just right, very comfortable.

khmer: ដោយឡែក / ជាពិសេស
breakdown: 专(focused)+门(door, field) — focused on one field

examples.en: I came specially to see you.
This is a specialized painting brush.

examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn zhuānmén mài huà.
examples.en: This shop specializes in selling paintings.

examples.py: Wǒ zhuānmén wèi nǐ zhǔnbèi de.
examples.en: I prepared this specially for you.

khmer: រង្វាន់
breakdown: Whole shape — a reward given for achievement

examples.py: Tā dé le yí ge jiǎng.

examples.cn: 她在美术比赛中得了奖。
examples.py: Tā zài měishù bǐsài zhōng dé le jiǎng.
examples.en: She won a prize in the art competition.

examples.py: Nǔlì cái néng ná dào jiǎng.

khmer: កាលពីក្មេង
breakdown: 小(small, young)+时候(time) — the time when you were small

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou hěn xǐhuan huà huà.
examples.en: I loved drawing when I was little.
He lived in the countryside as a child.

examples.cn: 小时候的事我记不清了。
examples.py: Xiǎoshíhou de shì wǒ jì bu qīng le.
examples.en: I can't clearly remember my childhood.

examples.py: Zhè shì wǒ xiǎoshíhou de zhàopiàn.
examples.en: This is a photo of me as a child.

examples.cn: 她小时候的理想是当画家。
examples.py: Tā xiǎoshíhou de lǐxiǎng shì dāng huàjiā.
examples.en: Her childhood dream was to be a painter.

english: to come into being; to produce; to arise
khmer: បង្កើត / កើតឡើង
breakdown: 产(produce, give birth)+生(be born) — bringing something into being

examples.cn: 这件事产生了很大的影响。
examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.en: This matter produced a big influence.

examples.py: Wǒ duì měishù chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
examples.en: I developed an interest in art.

examples.cn: 误会常常从不交流产生。
examples.py: Wùhuì chángcháng cóng bù jiāoliú chǎnshēng.
examples.en: Misunderstandings often arise from not communicating.

examples.cn: 这个想法是怎么产生的？
examples.py: Zhège xiǎngfǎ shì zěnme chǎnshēng de?
examples.en: How did this idea come about?

english: to count; to calculate; to count as
khmer: គិត / គណនា
breakdown: 竹(bamboo radical)+目+廾 — using bamboo counting sticks

examples.py: Qǐng suàn yíxià yígòng duōshao qián.

examples.en: Sixty points counts as a pass.
This counts as a success too.

examples.cn: 我们算算需要多少时间。
examples.en: Let's work out how much time we need.

khmer: បូក / បន្ថែម
breakdown: 力(strength)+口(mouth) — adding force or amount

examples.en: Please add a little more sugar.
The number of people increased a lot.

examples.py: Jiā shàng yùnfèi yígòng yìbǎi yuán.
examples.en: Adding shipping, it's a hundred yuan in total.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ wǒ jiā jìn zhège zǔ.
examples.en: Please add me to this group.

english: to be equal to; to equal
khmer: ស្មើនឹង
breakdown: 等(equal, 竹bamboo radical)+于(at, to) — being equal to

examples.en: This is the same as having done it for nothing.

khmer: សូន្យ
breakdown: 雨(rain radical)+令 — originally light rain drops; now the number zero

examples.py: Xiànzài shì shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn.

khmer: ផ្សេងទៀត
breakdown: 其(that)+他(he, it) — those others

examples.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào qítā de shì.
examples.en: I don't know about the other matters.

examples.cn: 其他班的学生也参加了。
examples.py: Qítā bān de xuésheng yě cānjiā le.
examples.en: Students from other classes also took part.
Except this one, all the others are fine.

english: to have nothing to do with (the frame 与……无关)
khmer: គ្មានទាក់ទងនឹង
breakdown: 与(with)+无(not have)+关(relation) — 'has no relation with', used as 与……无关

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì yǔ wǒ wúguān.
examples.en: This matter has nothing to do with me.
Success has nothing to do with age.
This problem has nothing to do with money.

examples.py: Tā de huà yǔ shìshí wúguān.
examples.en: What he said has nothing to do with the facts.
Happiness has nothing to do with being rich.

khmer: ទស្សនៈ
breakdown: 看(look)+法(way) — your way of looking at it

examples.cn: 每个人都有自己的看法。
examples.py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de kànfǎ.

khmer: អបអរសាទរ
breakdown: 祝(wish)+贺(congratulate) — wishing and congratulating

examples.py: Wǒ shōu dào le hěn duō zhùhè.
